name: @org-os/federation-map
description: org-os federation map. Framework-agnostic <federation-map> custom element drawing an instance's external world (peers, upstream and downstream instances, one hop beyond, sources and their ecosystems) as the house map: layered by the direction knowledge travels, static-first, keyboard-complete, with a list twin. Consumes map.json produced by @org-os/kms `render map`; never reads YAML itself.
